fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for change set 01M76XSY (Queue wait journal), serving m35-ship-40m. No owner took part. The planner read the daemon's pick code: every poll works out a Skip reason for each accepted change set (internal/daemon/pick.go, daemonPoll1 in internal/api/daemon.go), but daemon.state.json keeps only the last poll's skips, so a wait leaves no history. The machine hold already reports as the Skip reasons load-high and memory-low (internal/daemon/load.go). The planner raised three questions: where the wait is journaled, how the perf analysis reads it, and whether it is trimmed. The arbiter answered with Decision queue-wait-journal-file: an append-only queue.wait.jsonl in the daemon's per-clone folder, a line only when a change set's wait starts, changes reason, or its run starts, a typed line and reader in internal/daemon, read directly by the perf analysis, no CLI command, never trimmed. The planner wrote two leaves under daemon-picks: the daemon's journal lines, and the line type and reader.
fields.title: Queue wait journal plan (autonomous)
